We need to determine relation between two yes/no questions.

Question1: "O orçamento do programa de combate à tuberculose no Brasil deve ser ampliado?" => Should the budget of the TB control program in Brazil be increased?

Question2: "O projeto-piloto de erradicação da tuberculose deve ser concentrado apenas no Amazonas?" => Should the pilot project for TB eradication be concentrated only in Amazonas?

These are different issues: one about budget increase nationwide, the other about geographic concentration of a pilot project. Not opposite polarity; they are different questions. So relation = DIFFERENT.
